ocl.definition: currentCashDesk: CashDesk = CashDesk.allInstance()->any(o | o.IsOpened = true), postResult: Boolean = true
ocl.precondition: (CurrentSale.oclIsUndefined() = true) or (CurrentSale.IsComplete = true) and currentCashDesk.IsOpened = true
ocl.postcondition: let newSale:Sale in (newSale.oclIsNew() and newSale.BelongedCashDesk = currentCashDesk and newSale.IsComplete = false and newSale.IsReadytoPay = false and Sale.allInstance()->includes(newSale) and result = postResult)
